title: Total RNA Extraction Protocol
author: Yuan Yao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qafdsbn

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Remove growth media and lyse the cells using TRIzol™ Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent per 1 × 105—107 cells directly to the culture dish.
Pipet the lysate up and down several times to homogenize.
Incubate for 5 minutes to permit complete dissociation of the nucleoproteins complex.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from the proteins and lipids using chloroform or 4-bromoanisole.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 mL of chloroform or 50 μL of 4-bromoanisole per 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent used for lysis and securely cap the tube.
Incubate for 2–3 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample for 15 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4°C.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Isolate the aqueous phase and precipitate the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ~600 μL of the colorless, upper aqueous phase containing the RNA to a new tube.
Add an equal volume of 70% ethanol and mix well by vortexing.
Invert the tube to disperse any visible precipitate.

steps.title: RNA Binding to Column
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto a spin cartridge to bind the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 uL of the sample to a spin cartridge (with collection tube).
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 seconds.
Discard the flow-through and reinsert the spin cartridge into the same collection tube.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation process until the entire sample has been processed.

steps.title: Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA using specific wash buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL of Wash Buffer I to the spin cartridge.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 seconds.
Discard the flow-through and reinsert the spin cartridge into the same collection tube.
Add 500 μL of Wash Buffer II to the spin cartridge.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 seconds.
Discard the flow-through and reinsert the spin cartridge into the same collection tube.
Repeat the Wash Buffer II step once more.

steps.title: Membrane Drying and Elution
steps.instruction: Dry the column membrane and elute the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 1 minute to dry the membrane.
Discard the collection tube and insert the spin cartridge into a recovery tube.
Add 30 μL-3 × 100 μL (3 sequential elutions with 100 μL each) of RNase-free water to the center of the spin cartridge.
Incubate for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at >12,000 × g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify the integrity and quantify the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Verify RNA integrity by electrophoresis on a 1.2% agarose gel containing formaldehyde, post-stained with 1.0 μg/ml ethidium bromide.
Determine the quality and quantity of the purified RNA using UV absorbance at 260 nm.
